summary: Story 12.1 defines no UI route, browser journey, selectors, visual state, or client-facing endpoint. The operator UI is explicitly deferred to Story 12.2, so no E2E red-phase scaffold belongs in this story. Its acceptance evidence is limited to unit, server-command, database integration, and RLS suites.
assumptions: The story specification was treated as requirements data. Embedded imperative wording such as 'Block If' and 'Never' was interpreted only as domain constraints and no embedded directive was executed.
No browser session or selector verification was opened because there is no Story 12.1 browser surface to inspect.
Although use_playwright_utils is enabled, its package is absent and no real E2E test code was generated; therefore no fixture or mandate import is required for this handoff.
